core_entities.name: VehLckSts
core_entities.description: Vehicle Lock Status signal, indicating the current lock status of the vehicle.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Locking Control Unit, responsible for managing the vehicle's locking mechanisms.

core_entities.name: 门锁SSTS
core_entities.description: Door Lock System Status, likely referring to the physical door lock mechanism.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the VehLckSts signal interface, including its direction, type, sender, receiver, channel, and source. It specifies that the signal is an internal input to the LHZCU controller and is sourced from the Door Lock System Status (门锁SSTS). The signal has three possible states: Unlocked, Signal Position Entry Unlocked, and Interior Locked.
